fixtures.name: c-only
fixtures.description: clientId only, no wallet — 37 bytes, header 0x12 (v2 | has_c)

fixtures.name: w-only
fixtures.description: wallet only, no clientId — 41 bytes, header 0x22 (v2 | has_w)

fixtures.name: c-and-w
fixtures.description: clientId and wallet both present — 57 bytes, header 0x32 (v2 | has_c | has_w)

fixtures.name: empty-client-string-treated-as-absent
fixtures.description: c is the empty string, which the encoder treats as ABSENT rather than as an invalid UUID — it falls back to the wallet-only 41-byte layout and the decoded context has no "c" key at all

fixtures.name: timestamp-zero
fixtures.description: timestamp 0 (Unix epoch, uint32 lower bound) — the four timestamp bytes are 00000000

fixtures.name: timestamp-uint32-max
fixtures.description: timestamp 4294967295 (0xffffffff, uint32 upper bound) — VERIFIED ACCEPTED: the guard is t > 0xffffffff, so the boundary itself is inclusive and the four timestamp bytes are ffffffff

fixtures.name: timestamp-big-endian-byte-order
fixtures.description: timestamp 16909060 (0x01020304) — asserts BIG-endian byte order explicitly: the bytes must read 01020304, not 04030201

fixtures.name: uppercase-uuid-normalised
fixtures.description: UPPERCASE merchant and client UUIDs — the codec NORMALISES rather than rejects: its UUID regex is case-insensitive, so these bytes are byte-identical to the lowercase c-only fixture at the same timestamp, and decode always emits lower-case canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form

fixtures.name: mixed-case-wallet-normalised
fixtures.description: mixed-case (EIP-55-looking) wallet address — accepted without checksum validation and normalised to lower-case hex on decode

fixtures.name: all-zero-fields
fixtures.description: all-zero merchant UUID, timestamp 0 and all-zero client UUID — every payload byte after the header is 00, which catches implementations that skip writing zero fields

fixtures.name: all-ones-fields
fixtures.description: all-ff UUIDs, uint32-max timestamp and all-ff wallet — every payload byte after the header is ff, the maximal 57-byte payload

fixtures.name: reject-encode-merchant-not-uuid
fixtures.description: merchant id is not a UUID
fixtures.reason: m fails the RFC-4122 shape check

fixtures.name: reject-encode-client-not-uuid
fixtures.description: client id is a non-empty string but not a UUID
fixtures.reason: c is present (non-empty) but fails the UUID shape check

fixtures.name: reject-encode-wallet-malformed
fixtures.description: wallet address is not 0x + 40 hex characters
fixtures.reason: w fails isAddress and, with no c, the context has no identifier

fixtures.name: reject-encode-wallet-too-short
fixtures.description: wallet address is valid hex but only 39 characters long
fixtures.reason: w is the right shape but the wrong length

fixtures.name: reject-encode-missing-both-c-and-w
fixtures.description: neither clientId nor wallet is present
fixtures.reason: a V2 context MUST carry at least one identifier

fixtures.name: reject-encode-timestamp-negative
fixtures.description: timestamp is -1, below the uint32 range

fixtures.name: reject-encode-timestamp-overflow
fixtures.description: timestamp is 4294967296 (0x100000000), one past the uint32 range
fixtures.reason: t > 0xffffffff — note that 4294967295 is ACCEPTED, see timestamp-uint32-max

fixtures.name: reject-encode-timestamp-fractional
fixtures.description: timestamp is 1.5, not an integer
fixtures.reason: t fails the integer check

fixtures.name: reject-decode-empty-buffer
fixtures.description: zero-length buffer
fixtures.reason: shorter than the 21-byte header+merchant+timestamp minimum

fixtures.name: reject-decode-truncated-below-minimum
fixtures.description: the first 20 bytes of a valid c-only payload — below the fixed-field minimum
fixtures.reason: buffer shorter than header + merchant UUID + timestamp

fixtures.name: reject-decode-truncated-one-byte-short
fixtures.description: a valid 37-byte c-only payload with its last byte removed (36 bytes)
fixtures.reason: length disagrees with the length implied by the header flags

fixtures.name: reject-decode-one-byte-too-long
fixtures.description: a valid 37-byte c-only payload with one extra trailing 00 byte (38 bytes)
fixtures.reason: length disagrees with the header flags; trailing junk is not tolerated

fixtures.name: reject-decode-wrong-version-nibble
fixtures.description: a valid c-only payload whose header version nibble is 3 instead of 2 (0x12 -> 0x13)
fixtures.reason: version nibble is not 2 — guards against future formats

fixtures.name: reject-decode-version-nibble-v1
fixtures.description: a valid c-only payload whose header version nibble is 1 (0x12 -> 0x11)
fixtures.reason: V1 has no header byte at all, so a V2-shaped buffer claiming v1 is malformed

fixtures.name: reject-decode-reserved-bits-set
fixtures.description: a valid c-only payload with reserved header bit 7 set (0x12 -> 0x92)
fixtures.reason: reserved bits 6-7 must be 0

fixtures.name: reject-decode-no-flags-set
fixtures.description: a 37-byte payload whose header has both has_c and has_w cleared (0x12 -> 0x02)
fixtures.reason: a V2 payload must set at least one of has_c / has_w

fixtures.name: reject-decode-flags-disagree-with-length
fixtures.description: a 37-byte (c-only-sized) payload whose header claims has_w instead of has_c (0x12 -> 0x22)
fixtures.reason: flags imply 41 bytes but the buffer is 37 — the length check catches header/payload mismatch

fixtures.name: reject-decode-v1-length-buffer
fixtures.description: a bare 20-byte V1 wallet-address payload — the V2 decoder MUST refuse it while the outer length-based decompressor reads it as a V1 context (see decompressesTo). This is the V1-vs-V2 disambiguation: V1 is exactly 20 bytes, V2 is 37/41/57, so the two sets never overlap
fixtures.reason: 20 bytes is the V1 layout, below the V2 minimum

fixtures.name: reject-decompress-malformed-base64url
fixtures.description: a string containing characters outside the base64url alphabet
fixtures.reason: base64url decoding fails; decompress catches and returns nil

fixtures.name: reject-decompress-valid-b64-wrong-length
fixtures.description: well-formed base64url that decodes to 8 bytes — neither the V1 20-byte length nor any V2 length
fixtures.reason: decoded byte length matches no known layout

fixtures.name: reject-decompress-empty-string
fixtures.description: the empty string
fixtures.reason: empty input short-circuits to nil before decoding
